node.title: Re: Fetch array of values from hashref
node.author: k-mx
node.doctext: I think that code must be expressive, so it's nice when you use slices this way: my $h = { foo => 1, bar => 2 }; @{ $h }{qw/ foo bar /} = ( 667, 889 ); # or postfix form: # $h->@{qw/ foo bar /} = ( 667, 889 ); But for your problem, more clear solution would be: my @ar = values %$h; # or postfix form: # my @ar = values $h->%*; You can read more about slices here: perldoc perldata perldoc perlref
